findings.problem: With no hint, "finished, done" also allows erledigt (a task that's done) or vorbei (over, ended), so the learner can't tell that fertig is the answer wanted.
findings.fix: hint: said of a person, as in I'm done (with my work)

note: The new hint rules out "Ich bin erledigt", which means "I'm worn out", and it keeps this card apart from the word's other card, "ready".
